items.text: Secured funding from UN SDG Impact Fund, ETHDenver, Web3 Foundation / Polkadot, and NEAR — powering R&D like RealityChain.
Helped startups and enterprises secure multi-million-dollar rounds via tokens, equity, and hybrid models.
Architected and deployed public blockchains listed on major explorers — including Indonesia's CBDC prototypes.
Engineered and audited multiple full digital asset exchanges serving thousands of traders.
Trusted by banks, telcos, and state-owned enterprises to future-proof critical infrastructure.
Weekly national broadcast puts clients and partners in front of Indonesia's top tech decision-makers.

media.title: Shaping Indonesia's
media.lead: Catch this pivotal episode of Bloomberg Technoz, hosted by Blocksphere Director Pandu Sastrowardoyo, featuring CEO Gilang Bhagaskara and key voices from Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK).
media.sub: Each week, we unpack AI and Web3 shifts that matter to Indonesia's digital economy — showcasing the builders, regulators, and innovators driving transformation across the archipelago.

testimonials.quote: Blocksphere has played a pivotal role in the growth of Indonesia's blockchain ecosystem. Their commitment to innovation, education, and collaboration has helped bridge the gap between industry and regulators, driving real impact across the sector.
testimonials.name: Asih Karnengsih

testimonials.quote: Blocksphere has been a valuable tech partner for us at Ecoberingin. Their blockchain expertise helped us build trust and transparency in e-waste tracking — something that's been a game changer for our clients and regulatory partners.
testimonials.name: Widodo Goenanto

testimonials.quote: Blocksphere has consistently delivered strategic insight and deep technical expertise that align with the needs of enterprise-scale projects. Their contribution to blockchain adoption in Indonesia, especially within regulated industries, has been outstanding.
testimonials.name: Oscar Darmawan

team.title: Leadership
team.sub: The visionary leaders driving Indonesia's blockchain transformation through strategic expertise and innovative solutions.

members.name: Gilang Bhagaskara
members.bio: Visionary leader with over 9 years driving blockchain adoption across Indonesia's enterprise landscape. Expert at turning regulatory complexity into strategic opportunity — committed to digital sovereignty and mainstream blockchain utility.

members.name: Pandu Sastrowardoyo
members.bio: Entrepreneur, blockchain consultant, and serial innovator at the intersection of business, technology, and decentralization. AI and blockchain architect with deep experience in decentralized systems, bioinformatics, and enterprise strategy — MIT Professional Certificate in AI/ML. Co-founded Blockchain Zoo and the Indonesian Blockchain Association; hosts Bloomberg Technoz, bringing deep tech into mainstream business conversation.

members.name: Jean Daniel Gauthier
members.bio: Technical architect and business analyst bridging smart contract development with commercial viability. Leads intricate blockchain projects with precision — translating visionary concepts into scalable decentralized applications.
